title: Sukkah 2a — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 2 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-002.htm), questions 1–3.

questions.q: According to the Mishnah, if the sechach of the sukkah is higher than 20 amos, the sukkah is unfit (pesulah).
questions.explain: The Mishnah records a dispute: the Tana Kama holds it's unfit (option A, "True"); Rabbi Yehuda holds it's fit (option B, "False"). So the honest answer is the machloket between those two, not a flat true or false.

questions.q: Why in Eiruvin are we taught to repair an over-height mavoy (alleyway), while here we're taught that an over-height sukkah is simply unfit?
options: Sukkah is d'Oraisa — i.e. it was always unfit
Sukkah has too many details to go into all at once, otherwise we would
questions.explain: The Gemara actually gives two answers, not one: a sukkah is Torah law so it's simply stated as unfit, and/or a sukkah has too many detailed requirements to spell out a fix. Since both are genuinely offered, the answer is both A and B.

questions.q: Why can't a sukkah be higher than 20 amos?
options: A person must know he is sitting in a sukkah.
It must be able to be a dirah arai (temporary dwelling).
We must be in the tzel sukkah (shade of the sukkah).
questions.explain: All three reasons are genuinely given: Rabbah (awareness), Rava (temporary dwelling), Rebbi Zeira (shade). It's a three-way machloket, not any single one of them.
